name: emotion-terrain
description: 多维情绪景观自省空间
tagline: Feel your feelings, shape your landscape.
interaction: Users navigate a procedurally-generated 3D terrain where each emotional dimension (joy, anxiety, calm, anger) maps to a distinct geographical feature — mountains, storms, meadows, volcanoes. By selecting and adjusting emotion intensities via intuitive sliders, the landscape morphs in real-time, creating a personal emotional topography. Users can walk through their terrain in first-person, discovering hidden reflective prompts that emerge at the intersections of conflicting emotions.
